QuestInfo.1: Report what you found at the Lab to #b#p2300001##k.

0.1: You're disappointed, huh?\r\n#L0##bThe statistical chance of finding anything here was near impossible, yet there was a small percentage chance we would be successful. Why did I become so attached to that small chance?#l\n#k
0.2: I think that's called 'hope', #h0#. The humans seem to find comfort in it...

yes.0: Let's return to Veritas and report back to #bProfessor Dreamboat#k.

1.0: That took a long time. Did you find anything useful?\r\n#L0##b#p2300000# brought back some things, but #p2154009# seems to have destroyed anything useful.#l\n#k
1.1: I'll take a look and let you know if I find anything useful. Why don't you go relax while I get the others to analyze this stuff.

yes.0: I'm glad to have Roo-D back. The lab is so quiet without her. Professor Promathus has been moping around like a lost puppy.
